'''Prenda Novallo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. She worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Rusher's Brigade]], aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]&mdash;the [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']]&mdash;and in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], she accompanied the [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]], where they had been hired to [[Battle of Gazzari|fight]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. In the aftermath of the battle, the ''Diligence'' fled to the planet [[Byllura]] and on arrival, Novallo exited the ship with her engineering crews, to check its hull integrity.
